question: Does the substantive MLP17 repair transfer to genuinely fresh temporal v13, and is MLP12 a reproducible fidelity term rather than a threshold artifact?

evidence_scope.temporal: Genuinely fresh confirmation: first 12 jointly capable A1 and A2 rows from construction-disjoint v13.
evidence_scope.iswas: Replay/control only: all 30 capable v12 rows were already opened by augmentation discovery. No fresh is/was transfer claim is permitted.
evidence_scope.reason: Two preregistered is/was replacement authorities failed native capability before causal access; construction shopping stops.

frozen_design.arms: Direct, core-three, four-site, five-site, full-ten-site, and five leave-one-site-out arms (10 executed arms).
frozen_design.measurement: Behavior and both frozen physical reader modes against the full conditional-writer response; zero fitting or model updates.

predictions.pred_a_authority_replay_self_clamp_finit: All hashes/capabilities and gauge/replay/self-clamp/reconstruction instruments pass at exact price.
predictions.pred_b_four_site_mlp17_repair_transfers: On each task, the four-site arm has behavior signed projection >=0.75, both mode projections >=0.60, and every cell residual <=0.20; global behavior direction >=0.90.
predictions.pred_c_five_site_program_meets_strict_ce: Five-site behavior signed projection >=0.80 and both modes >=0.60 on each task, global direction >=0.90, and worst six-cell residual <=0.20.
predictions.pred_d_all_five_sites_have_mode2_support: Removing every retained site reduces mode-2 signed projection by >=0.02 on each task, and MLP17's temporal decrement is >=0.15.
predictions.pred_e_mlp12_is_a_reproducible_fidelity_: Five-site mean three-cell residual is lower than four-site on both tasks, and MLP12 raises is/was behavior signed projection by >=0.005.

decision: All gates yield temporal_fresh_five_mlp_response_program and license literal weight compilation with a fresh-temporal/provisional-iswas scope label. Instrument failure is invalid; otherwise temporal_response_program_transfer_null. No is/was freshness claim is recoverable from this run.
